release_notes: Wi-Fi Reliability, Network Switching & Credential Management: Interactive Wi-Fi scanner modal dialog on e-paper, on-screen touch virtual keyboard for entering passphrases directly on device, persistent Wi-Fi connectivity across all pages (Library, Bookstore, Reader, Settings), 3-tier credential hierarchy (NVS -> /flash/wifi.txt -> /sdcard/wifi.txt), auto-reconnect protection, status bar active Wi-Fi badge, and Web Sideload Portal Wi-Fi configuration card.
